name: On Edge
description: 'On Edge' is the sound of Greg Porn standing exactly where the title says. Greg Porn, the CWI co-production artist behind the DistroKid-verified 'Pay Yourself,' turns inward on this one: an underground hip hop record that treats paranoia and pressure as fuel. Co-produced by Black and released under Cumulative Web Inc, the track sits at the intersection of rap, hip hop, and nocturnal rap — late-night, introspective, and dangerous, with a wire-taut arrangement that never lets the listener relax. Production runs 808-driven and atmospheric: stuttering hi-hats throughout, synth pads layered underneath the verses, and a sparse percussion bed that leaves the vocals exposed and urgent. Greg Porn raps like a man counting exits — hypnotic in the verses, aggressive in the hook when it snaps — a dangerous, anxious performance that stays serious about its own unease. The low end is bass-heavy without being busy: a sub bass and bassline pulse running under vocal chops and ad-libs that answer the lead like second thoughts. For fans of nocturnal rap and underground trap, 'On Edge' recalls the catalog's dark, menacing chapters. It sits alongside 'Pay Yourself' as the middle panel of Greg Porn's CWI run — discipline on one side, something colder on the other — and it sounds like the moment before a decision gets made. As of October 2026 the track had no Spotify release, which only sharpens its status: this is the record you have to be in the room to hear, tense and menacing to the last bar.
